cgv.title: Terms and conditions of sale
cgv.intro: These terms govern the sale of trips and holidays by CLS Travel (Carthago Loisirs), a licensed travel agency, in accordance with Tunisian Law No. 73-21 on travel agencies and the Code of Obligations and Contracts.

sections.title: 1. Booking
sections.body: Any booking made on carthagoloisirs.com requires a client account and acceptance of these terms. The booking is confirmed as soon as the summary is validated, subject to availability.

sections.title: 2. Prices
sections.body: Prices are in Tunisian dinars (TND), per person, all taxes included. They cover the services listed under “What’s included” for each offer.

sections.title: 3. Payment terms
sections.body: No payment is collected online. Once the booking is confirmed, your advisor sends you the payment terms and schedule (cash, bank transfer or card at the agency). The balance must be paid no later than 30 days before departure.

sections.title: 4. Cancellation by the client
sections.body: Any cancellation must be notified in writing (client-area messaging or email). Fees: more than 30 days before departure, 10% of the total price; 30 to 15 days, 30%; 14 to 7 days, 50%; less than 7 days or no-show, 100%. Non-refundable visa fees and airline tickets remain due.

sections.title: 5. Changes or cancellation by the agency
sections.body: CLS Travel may have to change an essential element of the trip or cancel it (minimum number of participants not reached, force majeure, safety). The client is informed without delay and may accept the change or obtain a full refund of the amounts paid.

sections.title: 6. Travel formalities
sections.body: Each traveler is responsible for the validity of their documents (passport valid at least 6 months after return, visas, vaccinations). The details provided when booking must exactly match the passport.

sections.title: 7. Liability and insurance
sections.body: CLS Travel is responsible for the proper performance of the services provided for in the contract. Assistance-repatriation and cancellation insurance is strongly recommended and can be taken out on request.

sections.title: 8. Complaints and disputes
sections.body: Any complaint must be sent within 30 days of return. Failing an amicable agreement, the courts of Tunis have sole jurisdiction and Tunisian law applies.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.intro: In accordance with applicable regulations, here is the information about the publisher and host of carthagoloisirs.com.

sections.title: Publisher
sections.body: CLS Travel — Carthago Loisirs SARL, travel agency licensed by the Tunisian National Tourist Office. Head office: Avenue Habib Bourguiba, 1000 Tunis, Tunisia. Phone: +216 71 000 000. Email: contact@carthagoloisirs.com. Trade register and tax number available on request.

sections.title: Publication director
sections.body: The manager of Carthago Loisirs SARL.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.body: OVH SAS, 2 rue Kellermann, 59100 Roubaix, France — www.ovhcloud.com. Media files are stored on OVHcloud Object Storage (Gravelines region).

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: All website content (texts, photographs, logos, programmes) is protected. Any reproduction without prior written permission is prohibited.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: No payment is made on the website: payments are made directly with the agency. CLS Travel does not collect any card data online.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: CLS Travel takes the protection of your personal data seriously, in accordance with Tunisian Organic Law No. 2004-63 and, for our European clients, the GDPR.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: Identity and contact details (name, email, phone), traveler information needed for the booking (passport, date of birth), booking and payment history, and exchanges with our advisors. No card data is collected on the website.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: Managing your account and bookings, issuing tickets, visas and travel documents, invoicing, customer service, legal and accounting obligations and — with your consent — sending the newsletter.

sections.title: Recipients
sections.body: Our authorised advisors, our travel partners (airlines, hotels, ground handlers) strictly as needed, and our technical processors (OVHcloud for hosting, Resend for emails).

sections.title: Retention period
sections.body: Account data is kept while the account is active. Accounting records are kept for 10 years. Encrypted database backups are kept for 30 days.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Encrypted connection (HTTPS/HSTS), hashed passwords (bcrypt), time-limited sessions, logging of sensitive access and daily encrypted backups.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectify, object and erase your data. Write to contact@carthagoloisirs.com. Deleting an account anonymises it: bookings are kept for our accounting obligations.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: The website only uses essential technical cookies: login session (HttpOnly) and language preference. No advertising cookies are set.
